summary.text: Father of Periboea (`periboea-paeonian`), eldest of whose daughters lay with wide-flowing Axius and bore Pelegon (`pelegon-paeonian`) — named only in Asteropaeus' vaunt of river descent beside Scamander.

story.text: When Asteropaeus faced Achilles by the eddying Scamander, he claimed lineage through Pelegon, whom Axius begot upon Periboea, eldest of the daughters of Acessamenus.
